info.title: easyCMDB API
info.description:
easyCMDB is a configuration inventory: landscapes contain environments, environments contain resources, and resources can belong to applications.

Conventions:
- Ids are numeric strings, e.g. "42".
- Lists are not paginated. Inactive (soft-deleted) rows are hidden unless include_inactive=true.
- Deletes are soft. Audit fields (created_by, updated_by, deleted_by) come from the caller identity and cannot be set by clients.
- Roles: viewer can read everything; app_editor can also write applications; admin can write everything. Each operation lists its lowest allowed role in x-required-role. Call GET /me to see your role.
- Errors share one body shape, the Error schema.

Returns active applications, or all of them with include_inactive=true. Not paginated.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Include soft-deleted rows. Accepts true or 1; anything else is false.

post.description: app_alias is required and must be unique (409 if taken). Duplicate compliance tags are dropped. Requires the app_editor or admin role.

get.description: Returns one application by id, including soft-deleted ones.

patch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change. Changing app_alias to one already in use returns 409. Requires the app_editor or admin role.

delete.description: Deletes are soft: the row stays, with is_active=false and deleted_by set, and is hidden from lists unless include_inactive=true. Deleting an already inactive row is a no-op that still returns 204. Resources that reference the application are not deactivated with it. Requires the app_editor or admin role.

get.description: Returns active landscapes, or all of them with include_inactive=true. Not paginated.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Include soft-deleted rows. Accepts true or 1; anything else is false.

post.description: name is required and must be unique (409 if taken). Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns one landscape by id, including soft-deleted ones.

patch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change. Renaming to a name already in use returns 409. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes are soft: the row stays, with is_active=false and deleted_by set, and is hidden from lists unless include_inactive=true. Deleting an already inactive row is a no-op that still returns 204. Environments and resources in the landscape are not deactivated with it. Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns active landscape environments, or all of them with include_inactive=true. Not paginated.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Include soft-deleted rows. Accepts true or 1; anything else is false.

parameters.name: landscape_id

post.description: hosting_provider must be the code of an active hosting provider (it is upper-cased first). environment_name must be unique within the landscape, and hosting_provider plus provider_account_number must be unique (409). Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns one landscape environment by id, including soft-deleted ones.

patch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change. The same uniqueness and hosting_provider rules as create apply. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes are soft: the row stays, with is_active=false and deleted_by set, and is hidden from lists unless include_inactive=true. Deleting an already inactive row is a no-op that still returns 204. Resources in the environment are not deactivated with it. Requires the admin role.

parameters.description: Only return rows belonging to this landscape environment id.

post.description: landscape_environment_id must belong to landscape_id. When resource_scope is APPLICATION, application_id is required; when ENVIRONMENT, it must be null (400 otherwise). provider_resource_id must be unique within the environment (409). Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns one resource by id, including soft-deleted ones.

patch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change. The scope, landscape, and uniqueness rules from create are re-checked against the merged record. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes are soft: the row stays, with is_active=false and deleted_by set, and is hidden from lists unless include_inactive=true. Deleting an already inactive row is a no-op that still returns 204. Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns active hosting providers, or all of them with include_inactive=true. Not paginated.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Include soft-deleted rows. Accepts true or 1; anything else is false.

post.description: code is upper-cased, must be SCREAMING_SNAKE, must be unique (409), and cannot be changed later. Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns one hosting provider by id, including soft-deleted ones.

patch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change. code is immutable, so it is not accepted here. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes are soft: the row stays, with is_active=false and deleted_by set, and is hidden from lists unless include_inactive=true. Deleting an already inactive row is a no-op that still returns 204. Fails with 409 while active landscape environments still use the code. Requires the admin role.

Me.description: The caller identity as the API sees it.

code.description: Machine-readable code, present on domain errors.

details.description: Per-field validation messages, present on 400s from schema validation.

requestId.description: Request id to quote when reporting a 500.

Error.description: Error body returned for every 4xx and 5xx response.

BadRequest.description: The body, path, or query failed validation (details holds per-field messages), or a business rule was broken (code VALIDATION_ERROR).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the role may not make this change (code INSUFFICIENT_ROLE).

NotFound.description: No record with that id (code NOT_FOUND).

Conflict.description: A uniqueness rule or a dependent record blocks the change (code CONFLICT).

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. Quote requestId when reporting it.
